title: Microservices Architecture with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud
tldr: This lecture outlines building an employee management project as microservices architecture using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. The viewer learns the plan for three core services with separate MySQL databases, inter-service communication, service registry with Eureka, Config Server, API Gateway, distributed tracing with Sleuth and Zipkin, and circuit breaker plus React frontend.
